src: isolated control pixels not on the full bar rows/columns
path: straight ray in both directions perpendicular to the parallel full bars, stopping at the first bar cell reached in each direction; no ray where no bar is reached
trajectory: paint the control-to-hit segment with the control color
transform: after all rays, stamp a 3x3 block of the bar color centered on every hit and restore each center cell to the control color; keep other cells unchanged
